_comment: Read by the Pages deploy (.github/scripts/deploy-config.py). A game set to false under "games" is not built or published, and its card is left out of the library (index.html). Games not listed are deployed. A missing or unreadable file deploys every game. Each game's own <game>/deploy_config.json (e.g. bronzedrum's includeWorkbenches) still applies to the games that are deployed.
